program: Biostatistics PhD (Graduate Group in Epidemiology and Biostatistics, Perelman School of Medicine)

requirements.quote: Entering students in both the MS and PhD programs must have completed: at least one year of calculus, including multivariable calculus one semester of linear algebra at least one course in statistics have a working knowledge of a programming language
Advanced courses in mathematics are highly encouraged, particularly for students in the PhD program.
Previous experience with data analysis and statistical packages is desirable but not required.

problems: The required list is a bulleted list on the page ('Admission Requirements: Prior Coursework'); the quote is the list joined as the page text renders it.

Required: >=1 year calculus incl. multivariable calculus, 1 semester linear algebra, >=1 statistics course, working knowledge of a programming language. 'Advanced courses in mathematics' (e.g. real analysis) are not named specifically.
